dedupe_keys.name: sam sustainable analytical model building toolkit

description: SAM is the core repository of the Sustainable Analytical Model toolkit for preparing analytical building models. Engineers can describe constructions, loads and systems, then use extension modules to connect those representations to environmental and energy simulation tools. Inputs are a building's geometry, fabric, use and service assumptions; outputs are model objects and scenario-ready definitions for downstream analyses. Coverage is a user-specified building or portfolio, with no default city or period. The repository offers an installer, source-build guidance and a wiki, and states free LGPL-3.0-or-later terms. Its Visual Studio, Windows and Grasshopper workflows mean the practical setup depends on the chosen modules. A limitation is that this core library does not itself prove a building's measured energy use or replace calibration of a downstream simulation engine. SAM can prepare retrofit or HVAC scenarios; the catalogue's OpenStudio is one separate engine with which external integrations may work. No installer, building model or package was downloaded.
